posts.title: 28 years later, still playing the same game.
posts.description: Wrapped up Wall Market, got all the parts for Cloud's outfit. I'm using the Shinra Archaeology mod so it's a little different but not outrageously so. It adds some extra scenes in the Honeybee Inn which are mostly just comical and weird. It gets you to the same result.

posts.title: Avalanche: Like a Jenova
posts.description: I'm on a boat and what do you do when you're on a boat? You play in a TCG tournament of course. You know, I've been on multiple cruises and none of them have had this. This would have been an improvement to all of them. The matches were all fairly easy but still fun. I only had to restart one against Madam M due to a minor lapse.
